title: The Wayward Prism - free vibe coded 3d jrpg (heavily influenced by suikoden/star ocean)
author: Odd_Cauliflower6672
selftext:
This was a fun little side project that turned out quite well. There is more story of the dev process itself in the OP,  typed out in a joking mood - but mostly accurate. Including my own testing of the game, this project was in development for 2 weeks. Mostly handled by claude code w/opus 5.5, I would say approximately 20 hours of my own time. The rest was essentially dev iteration/review through claude code. The Tripo models work pretty well here, but would not be great with higher zoom levels as there are defects (especially in the eyes). It is best played with a controller, but can be played without.

TLDR;  
Suikoden-style story, fort progression, and characters.  
Star Ocean-style combat system using Unity MLAgents trained AI models.
